patches.summary: Default the {userId} template var to "me" instead of a placeholder outside verify mode.
patches.reason: Every Gmail path is /users/{userId}/...; "me" is the only value that makes sense for a personal OAuth token, so the generated placeholder made every request 404 until GMAIL_USER_ID was set by hand.
patches.validated_outcome: users-profile me and all generated endpoint commands resolve against the live API without GMAIL_USER_ID set.

patches.summary: Treat a refresh-token-only config as incomplete so the access token still merges from the credentials file.
patches.reason: hasCompleteCredentialFields returned true when only RefreshToken was set, so config.Load skipped the credentials-file merge and left AccessToken empty; the generated TestPartialConfigCredentialsMergeMissingFields failed out of the box.
patches.validated_outcome: go test ./internal/config ./internal/cliutil passes; partial-config merge test green.

patches.summary: Bare `sync` delegates to the hand-authored mailbox pull flow instead of an empty resource loop.
patches.reason: messages.list returns bare ids, so the generic per-resource sync could never hydrate a useful local store; the emitted defaultSyncResources was empty and `sync` was a runtime no-op while framework hints still told users to run it.
patches.validated_outcome: sync with no flags mirrored 1262 live messages, 0 skipped; dogfood's sync-no-op warning cleared.

patches.summary: Populate the emitted resourceReadPaths/resourceReadConfigs maps for messages, threads, labels, drafts, and filters.
patches.reason: The generator emitted empty maps, leaving `tail` with zero valid resources (a runtime no-op) and `export`'s batch mode without a resolvable list path.
patches.validated_outcome: verify's resource-path checks for tail and export cleared; verify pass rate 100%.

patches.summary: Register root-level novel commands via guarded direct rootCmd.AddCommand instead of the addNovelCommandIfAbsent indirection.
patches.reason: The indirection hides registrations from every static command-tree consumer, so dogfood's depth check reported `schedule send` as registered under drafts/messages and the scorecard missed the novel leaves.
patches.validated_outcome: dogfood novel-feature depth mismatch cleared; 6/6 novel features detected.

patches.summary: Point tail's help example at a real resource instead of the nonexistent "events" resource.
patches.reason: The generated example referenced a resource this spec does not define, so copy-pasting it failed.

patches.summary: Register the filters diff/apply leaves with direct cmd.AddCommand instead of addNovelCommandIfAbsent.
patches.reason: The indirection hides child registrations from static command-tree analysis, so the library's skill verifier parsed `filters diff --file` as a positional arg plus an unknown flag on `filters`.
patches.validated_outcome: Library CI check 'Validate SKILL.md against shipped CLI source' passes.

patches.summary: Treat refresh token plus client id as authenticated in `auth status`.
patches.reason: The generated check was `cfg.AccessToken != ""`, so a refresh-token-only config reported FAIL while every live command succeeded by minting a token on demand.
patches.validated_outcome: auth status reports credentials present; users-profile returns live data with the same config.

patches.summary: Stamp an RFC 5322 Message-ID at queue time and verify delivery against Gmail before re-sending a previously attempted item.
patches.reason: Stale-claim recovery requeued items that had already been accepted by Gmail but crashed before the completion write, so an interrupted run delivered the same email twice.
patches.validated_outcome: Message-ID persists in scheduled_sends; deliverDue queries rfc822msgid: for any item with attempts>1 and marks it sent instead of resending.

patches.summary: Hold the history cursor when any changed message failed to store instead of advancing past it.
patches.reason: Advancing to the newest historyId after a skip stepped the window past those ids permanently, so they never reached the mirror, search, or analytics.
patches.validated_outcome: Incremental pull reports the held cursor on stderr and retries the ids on the next run; clean runs still advance.

patches.summary: Reconcile upstream deletions during the windowed resync that follows a cursor expiry.
patches.reason: The resync only upserted; messages deleted while the cursor was expired lingered in offline search and analytics forever.
patches.validated_outcome: pruneMissingInWindow deletes in-window rows Gmail no longer lists, and only runs when the listing was complete (not limit-truncated, not query-narrowed, nothing skipped).

patches.summary: Count terminal per-part batch statuses (400/404) as failed instead of feeding them back into the retry set.
patches.reason: Terminal failures were retried through all four backoff rounds, spending quota and up to fifteen seconds to reach the same answer.
patches.validated_outcome: A 404 part returns after one call with no backoff; only 403/429/5xx are retried.
